name: Chunked Voxel Map Serialization with Visfaces
definition: Iterates over a chunked voxel map to serialize blocks into a file, computing a 6-bit visibility face mask (visfaces) for each block based on solid neighbors.
summary: Chunked Voxel Map Serialization with Visfaces serializes voxel maps into compact files by computing 6-bit visibility masks for rendering culling, distinguishing itself from span-based encoding by tracking surface orientation.
